## WF-03: AI Classification Engine

Standalone, reusable sub-workflow. Called by WF-02 (Alarm Normalizer) via an 'Execute Workflow' node, passing the standardized alarm JSON.

Flow:
Execute Workflow Trigger -> Validate Input -> Build Claude Prompt -> Call Claude API -> Parse & Validate AI Output -> Apply Business Rules -> Compute Confidence Routing -> [Auto-Approved | Manual Review | Human Validation Required]

Invalid input, failed AI calls, and malformed AI responses each route to their own Error Output.

No Google Sheets, no Telegram, no Slack, no Email, no ticketing, no dashboard - AI classification only.

### Error handling summary
- Missing required input fields -> Error Output - Invalid Input
- Claude API call fails/times out (after 3 retries, 2s apart, 30s timeout) -> Error Output - AI Call Failed
- Claude responds but output isn't valid JSON or is missing required fields -> Error Output - Invalid AI Response (raw text preserved for debugging)

Every path returns a structured JSON object. Nothing is ever dropped silently.

### Confidence routing
>90% -> Auto-Approved (proceed automatically downstream)
70-90% -> Manual Review (flagged for a NOC engineer to confirm)
<70% -> Human Validation Required (must be reviewed before any action is taken)

All 3 branches output the identical JSON shape - only 'reviewStatus' and which terminal node it reached differ.
